messages:
alex_w: ACME onboarding - running into preflight 429s almost immediately after the first ramp. They say they followed quickstart. Any known gotchas?

tina_k: Can you paste the exact error payload + SDK version? We fixed a preflight double-send bug in 0.9.3 but some customers still hit patterns that explode quota.

alex_w: Gateway response: `429 preflight_quota_exceeded`. Headers: `x-rate-reset: 12`, `x-request-count: 101`. Node SDK v0.9.2. Minimal log: 

```

POST /v1/preflight 429
{ "error":"preflight_quota_exceeded", "retry_after": 12 }
x-request-count: 101
```
jordan_cs: FYI ACME's integration spawns 8 worker threads on page load, each calls `sdk.init()` + preflight. That fanout will definitely hit the preflight window.

lea_infra: Yep — that pattern is the root cause. Preflight is counted per distinct preflight call; if you parallelize across N workers you multiply the window. Two quick mitigations: consolidate into a single shared init on first load, or add ephemeral token handshake with one warmup caller + short TTL and let others reuse. Also add jitter/splay on client init.

alex_w: Sent suggested quick fix: add a randomized delay before preflight to reduce fanout. Example: 

```js
// simple splay
await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, Math.floor(Math.random()*2500)));
await sdk.init({ apiKey: ephemeralKey });
```
Also suggested centralizing `init()` in the SPA root rather than per-iframe.

tina_k: Also check they didn't inadvertently call `sdk.init()` in both the embed and the host app (we've seen SPA + embed duplication double preflight). Can you grep for `init(` in their bundle?

alex_w: They did have duplicate init — removing one cut the preflight rate ~50% immediately :relieved:. I'll push the hotfix to staging and confirm.

deploy-bot: rollout 2026-03-20 03:12 UTC: release sdk@0.9.3 — added preflight dedupe + backoff helpers.

jordan_cs: I'll follow up with ACME and send a snippet that instruments `x-request-id`, honors `retry_after`, and exposes a warmup endpoint. Marking as at-risk until they confirm stable behavior. I'll also ping @sam_account_exec for renewal check-in.

alex_w: Thanks all — I'll update the support ticket with the steps (dedupe init, add jitter/backoff, upgrade to 0.9.3) and set account health to "at-risk" for one week. Will report back with metrics after their next deploy. :thumbsup:
